# Spore Card
> A PNG card that carries a verified 41-byte seed in its pixels. Save the card, drop it into the grower, and a working model germinates locally and offline — reproducing a held-out AUC of 0.820498 on 4,725 unseen sessions, with a receipt you re-run.

## What it is
- A seed, not a download link: the picture carries the genome; growing fits a real model on your own machine.
- Two layers: a redundant visible module band (survives a screenshot/re-encode) and a lossless PNG chunk (exact, for a file that travels intact).
- A CRC-16 refuses a corrupt read rather than growing the wrong thing.

## Verify (re-run beats attest)
- Germinate the seed `◊ spore.v1 funnel 11 f:579fc3f04c233901` — it reproduces held-out AUC 0.820498, the figure fall-spore sealed in commit 4c3ab7b.
- Run the mutation gate: `npm run witness` (exit 0 only if the card codec is clean).

## The mesh
- A signed (v2) card binds seed + claimed score + data tag + Ed25519 key. A receiving node checks the seal, then that it holds the data, then RE-RUNS the seed: the score must reproduce or the card is refused, however well signed.
- receipts/edge-verify.json re-runs byte-for-byte in CI (node tools/edge-receipt.mjs --check).

## Hand off the heavy work
- A requester signs a job (grow spore, data tag, evals cap, nonce, expiry, and the one worker key it is addressed to). The worker refuses a tampered, expired, replayed, misaddressed, not-allowed or over-limit job before it grows anything; running jobs is opt-in.
- The answer is a v3 card: the champion as a fixed seed, its score, and a citation of the exact job, signed by the worker. The requester checks the citation and the signer, then re-runs the seed — the score must reproduce.
- An optional model (local, or the user's own key) may only PROPOSE genomes; each is kept only if it wins on the grow's inner split. The job passes with no model.
- receipts/job-roundtrip.json and receipts/byok-roundtrip.json re-run in CI (tools/job-receipt.mjs --check, tools/byok-receipt.mjs --check).
- Limits: a re-run proves the claim, not that the worker found the best genome; both nodes ran on one machine (two-device run pending).

## Card stages
- A card can grow: each stage is grown on the holder's machine from the stage before, with a seed number tied to the holder's key, and counts only if it beats the starting model and every earlier stage on a fresh check split. The signed history rides on the card.
- Any holder re-checks the whole history: signatures and order instantly, then every stage re-run (its held-out score reproduces; it climbs; re-grown for that key it lands on the same model). A copied, hand-picked or edited stage is refused. Held-out is measured, never used to decide.
- receipts/stage-unlock.json re-runs in CI with every attack (laundered, stolen seed, flipped, spliced, false score, ungrown); receipts/stage-webrtc.json is the live two-browser trade (A grows, B re-checks and grows the next stage under its own key, A re-checks).
